answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks 50 units in escrow, earns a copper badge after work: it must wander across three markets, not repeat one script, and each job adds a signal to its fingerprint. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 units plus weeks of distinct behavior; identical fingerprints lose all deposits. An honest agent pays once, unlocks after 20 epochs, and keeps undiluted rewards.
